description:
Enterprise Account Executive, Electric Utilities

Mach9 builds AI CAD software that turns 3D scans of roads, utilities, and infrastructure into engineering-ready drawings for civil engineers. We're looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to help Mach9 unlock rapid growth with electric utilities.

The Role

You'll build relationships with some of the largest infrastructure owners in North America, introduce AI into critical engineering and asset management workflows, and turn initial engagements into long-term enterprise partnerships. This role reports to the Head of Solutions Engineering.

As an early member of our utilities sales team, you'll have the opportunity to shape our go-to-market strategy, develop strategic accounts, and help define how electric utilities adopt AI at scale.

What You'll Do

  • You will develop and maintain relationships with key decision-makers across investor-owned utilities, municipal utilities, and electric cooperatives, including executive leadership and technical teams.

  • You will build pipeline through your existing industry network, targeted outbound, strategic partners, engineering firms, and industry events. You'll understand when to engage utilities directly and when to leverage their engineering and technology partners.

  • You will uncover how utilities collect, process, and use infrastructure data, identify the teams and stakeholders responsible for these workflows, and develop opportunities where Mach9 can deliver meaningful business value. You will develop LiDAR and photogrammetry workflows for teams with and without such experience.

  • You will develop multithreaded account strategies spanning transmission and distribution engineering, survey and geomatics, GIS, asset management, IT, procurement, and executive leadership.

  • You will quantify the value of Mach9 using customer-specific metrics, including engineering productivity, project turnaround times, operational backlogs, and outsourced service costs.

  • You will build the business case from the utility's own numbers: miles captured, drafting hours per mile, turnaround, backlog and outsourced spend.

  • You will navigate technical evaluations, vendor onboarding, security reviews, legal negotiations, and procurement to secure initial deployments and establish paths toward broader enterprise adoption.

  • You will work with customers to identify additional use cases, build internal champions, and expand successful deployments into long-term, six and seven-figure relationships.

  • You will develop strategic account plans, maintain accurate pipeline forecasts, and apply structured qualification methodologies to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • You will collaborate closely with our founders, solutions engineering, customer success, and product teams to bring market insights into our roadmap and help build a repeatable utilities sales motion.

  • You will build relationships through customer visits, industry associations, strategic partnerships, and events such as DISTRIBUTECH and Geo Week.

  • You will use AI tools and agents to accelerate account research, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation, and sales execution while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and judgment.

What You Bring

  • You have 7+ years of experience selling enterprise software or complex technical solutions into electric utilities, energy, or other critical infrastructure markets, including 3+ years owning full-cycle sales.

  • You have a strong understanding of the electric utility industry, including organizational structures, operational priorities, budgeting processes, and how major technology purchasing decisions are made.

  • You have successfully developed new utility accounts, built relationships with technical and executive stakeholders, and navigated complex enterprise sales cycles.

  • You have a track record of closing six-figure enterprise deals and expanding initial projects or pilots into broader, multiyear customer relationships.

  • You bring an established network of relationships across electric utilities, engineering firms, or technology partners serving the industry.

  • You are comfortable navigating utility procurement, vendor onboarding, security reviews, and complex enterprise negotiations.

  • You can engage credibly with engineering and technical teams, understand complex workflows, and translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes. Experience with LiDAR, GIS, geospatial data, or engineering software is a plus, but not required.

  • You take ownership of your results, move with urgency, operate independently, and thrive in an environment where you're helping build the playbook.

  • You are disciplined in how you qualify opportunities, manage your pipeline, and forecast revenue. You know when to pursue an opportunity and when to walk away.

  • You are curious about AI and actively use emerging tools to improve your productivity, research, and sales execution.

  • You are willing to travel regularly to build customer relationships, develop strategic opportunities, and attend industry events.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with PLS-CADD, transmission and distribution asset workflows, vegetation management or GIS platforms.

  • Experience with usage-based pricing or land-and-expand motions.

  • Experience building a new market or motion at an early-stage company (Series A to C).

Benefits

  • Equity ownership in Mach9

  • 100% employee coverage for medical, dental, and vision

  • 401(k)

  • Unlimited PTO and 8 paid holidays

  • Unlimited Cursor, ChatGPT, and Claude credits

  • Monthly team offsites (go-karting, Topgolf, and more)

How We Work

This role is remote within the United States. It includes travel to customer sites and industry events up to 35% of the time.

About Mach9

Mach9 is the AI CAD platform for civil engineering, built to expand the world's capacity to build and maintain critical infrastructure. Its software turns 3D scans into engineering-ready CAD drawings, helping teams work up to 10x faster and at one-fifth the cost. Mach9 has been used across more than 2,500 projects in all 50 states and four continents, surveying over 100,000 miles of infrastructure, including for more than 50% of America's top 10 engineering firms and some of the top investor-owned utilities.

In October 2026 we raised a $34M Series A co-led by First Round Capital and Bessemer Venture Partners. Founded by engineers from Carnegie Mellon's Robotics Institute who built systems for the physical world at Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, NASA and Google X, Mach9 is headquartered in San Francisco. Learn more at mach9.ai.

Equal Opportunity

Mach9 is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act.
